name: Sage Creative Agency
tagline: A 30-slide creative proposal with sage and indigo fields, elegant Tenor Sans capitals, orange accents, and capsule-framed editorial photography.

palette.description: Pale sage and deep indigo alternate with warm orange circles and softly graded editorial photography.

typography.style: Light uppercase Tenor Sans display at 150px / 75px on a 1920 × 1080 canvas, paired with Open Sans 20px / 24px and bold small labels; both families embedded.

best_for: Creative studios, editorial brands, photographers, and service proposals that need a complete narrative from introduction and team to capabilities, testimonials, budget, pricing, and contact.
avoid_for: Chart-heavy financial reporting or dense operational dashboards; body copy should remain short enough for the fixed editorial composition.

source_inspiration.name: ThisIsHome Studio — Creative Agency Pitch Deck
source_inspiration.notes: Full 30-page public preview reconstructed as editable positioned HTML text, native SVG circles and rules, and independently replaceable capsule-cropped photographs. Preserves observed Tenor Sans / Open Sans typography, 1920 × 1080 composition, #1F277B / #D4DECE colors, and individual image transforms. All 28 distinct photographs containing people or human details are AI generated, following the observed composition, wardrobe, camera angle, lighting, and photographic direction. The 31 source image IDs map to those 28 AI assets; one botanical pond photograph remains from the public source preview.
